_doc: A 20 x 20 mm slotted aluminium profile as sold unbranded ("2020, 20x20 slot 6, B-type"): a stand-in until the bar in hand is measured (cad measure, or a caliper and cad rules draft profile). Its outline is one named seller's CAD outline (KJN), its section figures and alloy another's catalogue (Dold Mechatronik), and every figure is community. Stock from the Far East sold as "2020 EU standard" is a different section (a slot 6.2 wide, 11 under the lips and 6.1 deep, a round 5 mm bore, about 0.5 kg/m). The drawn outline leaves out the four notches round the bore, the step at each mouth and the V groove in each slot's floor, so its torsion constant comes out high.
